seen.rebuild_constraint: Replace globToRegex/gmatch with a LINEAR-TIME non-backtracking matcher (two-pointer with backtrack memo, or DP over pattern x path). BORROW: port nektos/act pkg/workflowpattern (MIT, correct GitHub semantics, scores 49/49) rather than hand-roll — hand-rolling is what produced the XSS then the ReDoS. VERIFY against lib/checks/gha-filter-oracle.json (46 published pairs) + lib/checks/redos-probes.json (must resolve <50ms each, no UI freeze) + lib/checks/xss-payloads.json. Add the LIVE analytics beacon (ship 002 predates it). Kill-criterion in per-path visits, not tool-runs. [2026-08-03 CORRECTION, from reading the port source rather than trusting the plan: act is linear-time because Go's regexp is RE2, NOT because of its pattern translation. PatternToRegex emits ordinary regex text. A VERBATIM JS PORT WOULD REINTRODUCE THE ReDoS, because JS RegExp backtracks. Port act's SEMANTICS line-for-line; execute them on a Thompson NFA / Pike-VM state-set simulation, never on JS RegExp.]
